part_functions.name: Levered load transmission
part_functions.function: Transmits tensile, compressive, or manually applied lever loads between the left clevis pivot and the right hook interface.

part_functions.name: Pivoting attachment
part_functions.function: The split left end accepts a transverse pin and permits rotation about the Y-directed pin axis.

part_functions.name: Hooked engagement
part_functions.function: The curved right end captures or acts against a mating pin, edge, cable, or latch element while the terminal post resists disengagement.

part_functions.name: Integral structural relationship
part_functions.function: A single tapered spine integrally joins the clevis and hook sections; paired clevis lugs and major side surfaces are approximately symmetric about the Y=0 center plane.

sections.name: Left split clevis and pivot eye

section_functions.name: Location and geometry
section_functions.function: Located at the negative-X end; consists of two rounded, Y-separated lugs surrounding a central slot, with coaxial transverse bore segments.

section_functions.name: Joint behavior
section_functions.function: Receives a mating tab in the central slot and a cross-pin through both lugs, forming a double-shear pivot joint.

section_functions.name: Structural relationships
section_functions.function: The two lugs are mirrored across Y=0, their bore segments are coaxial along Y, and the slot termination transfers pin reaction into the tapered spine.

features.name: Paired rounded clevis lugs and central slot

feature_functions.name: Geometry
feature_functions.function: Two radius-7.5 mm rounded outer lug ends flank a 7 mm-wide central slot whose closed end is at approximately X=-60.75 mm.

feature_functions.name: Load support
feature_functions.function: Supports the pivot pin on both sides of the mating member and distributes bearing and bending loads into the arm.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Negative-Y lug outer rounded surface, radius 7.5 mm.
Negative-Y planar wall of the central clevis slot, including the bore opening boundary.
Closed inner end wall of the clevis slot at X=-60.75 mm.
Positive-Y planar wall of the central clevis slot, including the bore opening boundary.
Positive-Y lug outer rounded surface, radius 7.5 mm.

feature_functions.name: Pin interface
feature_functions.function: Provides two radius-3 mm cylindrical bearing surfaces for a transverse pivot pin.

feature_functions.name: Physical behavior
feature_functions.function: The separated bore segments align the pin along Y and place the mating central member primarily in double shear.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Radius-3 mm pivot-bore segment through the negative-Y clevis lug.
Radius-3 mm pivot-bore segment through the positive-Y clevis lug, coaxial with face 1.

section_functions.name: Location and geometry
section_functions.function: Extends along X between the left clevis and right hook; its width and depth taper toward the hook end and its major surfaces have small longitudinal draft angles.

section_functions.name: Structural behavior
section_functions.function: Acts as the primary beam, transmitting axial force, bending moment, and torsion while reducing material away from the more heavily built pivot end.

section_functions.name: Section relationships
section_functions.function: Integrally supports both end interfaces; the positive-Y and negative-Y side surfaces form a mirrored pair, while the upper and lower planes bound the beam depth.

feature_functions.name: Load path
feature_functions.function: Provides a continuous material path between the pivot joint and hook, with gradual tapering to limit stress concentrations and mass.

feature_functions.name: Physical behavior
feature_functions.function: The broad upper and lower faces resist bending, while the paired side faces carry shear and stabilize the arm laterally.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Long upper drafted surface of the tapered spine.
Long negative-Y side surface extending between the end sections.
Long lower drafted surface of the tapered spine.
Long positive-Y side surface mirrored with face 9.

section_functions.name: Location and geometry
section_functions.function: Located at the positive-X end; combines a concave hook throat, enlarged rounded heel, and an upstanding semicylindrical retaining nose.

section_functions.name: Engagement behavior
section_functions.function: The throat seats against a mating element, the rounded heel spreads contact and transition loads, and the terminal nose obstructs outward escape.

section_functions.name: Structural relationships
section_functions.function: The hook throat is adjacent to the tapered spine and terminal nose; the nose is centered about Y=0 and its side boundaries are symmetric at Y=±3 mm.

features.name: Concave hook throat and upper transition

feature_functions.name: Capture interface
feature_functions.function: The radius-3 mm concave cylindrical throat receives a rounded mating edge or pin and redirects applied force into the hook body.

feature_functions.name: Retention transition
feature_functions.function: The smaller upper curved transition joins the throat to the retaining nose and reduces the open escape path.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Primary concave radius-3 mm hook-throat surface with axis parallel to Y.
Short radius-3 mm curved transition from the throat toward the top of the retaining nose.

feature_functions.name: Geometry
feature_functions.function: Large radius-9 mm convex cylindrical underside wrapping around the right-end hook body.

feature_functions.name: Load distribution
feature_functions.function: Provides material beneath the throat, spreads contact and bending stresses, and turns the spine load path upward into the retaining nose.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Large radius-9 mm convex outer heel and underside of the hook.

feature_functions.name: Retention
feature_functions.function: Forms the raised terminal barrier that resists a seated mating element sliding out of the hook throat.

feature_functions.name: Physical behavior
feature_functions.function: The vertical cylindrical wall carries lateral contact, while the top cap and paired side faces close and stabilize the terminal geometry.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Narrow negative-Y side face connecting the heel to the terminal retaining post.
Radius-3 mm vertical-axis outer cylindrical wall of the terminal retaining post.
Flat top cap of the terminal retaining nose at Z=15 mm.
Narrow positive-Y side face connecting the heel to the terminal retaining post.
